lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated gains for winning tests in home notifications, adoption new flows, sign-in reorders, and choose path layouts.

Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) were helpful across multiple winning tests.

Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) either caused rollbacks due to negative impacts or showed no clear effect.

Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, home new_flow, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Waiting Screen Step
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the waiting screen, after pet assets have finished generating.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in has previously delivered significant conversion gains. Prompting sign-in after pet generation completes ties account creation directly to the newly created pet.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after the waiting screen within onboarding is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in is a proven pattern (+1.2% historical gain across 5 tests) targeting moderate drop-off.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Voice Preview Companion Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive audio voice sample component to companion choices on the pick friend screen.
candidates.why: Adoption new flows have strong evidence of success. Allowing users to hear pet audio samples increases emotional connection during adoption selection.

guard.reason: Adding an audio voice preview component to the pick friend screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off (24.3%), and new flow additions in adoption consistently perform well (+1.1%).

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a clean two-column layout contrasting preset companion adoption against custom photo upload.
candidates.why: Choose path layout changes consistently yielded conversion improvements in previous winning tests, helping users decide faster (currently 514s mean time).

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose path screen layout while retaining both options is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Target step has high latency (514s), but layout redesigns show mixed to neutral historical lifts (+0.0%).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Pre-flight Verification Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated image quality verification screen right after photo upload before sending photos to render.
candidates.why: Support emails show user frustration with failed or malformed custom pet generation. Verifying uploads prevents generation errors before entering the waiting phase.

new_photo_verify.headline: Verify Photo Quality
new_photo_verify.body: Ensure your pet photo is clear before starting generation.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality verification screen inside onboarding sub-flows is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Support mail highlights upload issues, but inserting new screens adds friction and historically hurts conversion.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Grid Display Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection interface using a grid layout that displays all available companions simultaneously.
candidates.why: Redesigning the pet selection view helps streamline decision-making on adoption (currently 75.7% conversion).

guard.reason: Rebuilding the pick friend interface with a grid layout is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption drop-off is high, but adoption redesigns consistently underperformed (-2.5% across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Audio Chime Notification
candidates.change: Triggers a audio completion chime when pet asset creation finishes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home notifications are proven winners across multiple tests. Audio cues effectively alert users who stepped away during long render wait times.

guard.reason: Adding an audio completion chime to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses huge mean wait time (2336s); home notifications are strong proven winners (+1.8% across 5 tests).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Render Estimate Progress Display
candidates.change: Displays an estimated time countdown timer component on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high mean latency (2336s). Clear wait duration expectations reduce drop-off caused by perceived hanging.

guard.reason: Displaying a countdown timer on the waiting screen for a real wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses 2336s waiting step latency, with positive historical evidence (+0.9% across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Story Screen Compact View Layout
candidates.change: Update the story screen to use a compact layout for faster initial browsing.
candidates.why: The first step conversion is 78.5%. Streamlining the initial story presentation reduces initial drop-off.

guard.reason: Updating the story screen layout to a compact view is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Choose path layout changes are highlighted as helpful across winning tests to reduce drop-off.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Mastery Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Display an exclusive onboarding completion badge on the final intro screen.
candidates.why: The finish step has a 71.4% conversion rate. Providing a completion reward encourages users to perform final setup steps.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras, gifts, or completion badges.

candidates.title: Home Intro Full Bleed Experience Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: The finish step takes a median of 395s. A visually immersive full-bleed layout creates an exciting conclusion to onboarding.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off, but finish redesigns have failed consistently (-5.8% avg) causing rollbacks.
